dedupe_keys.name: historical weather load wind and solar data for the salt river project

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes hourly weather, electricity-load and renewable-generation inputs for the Salt River Project service territory during 1980–2019. The November 2023 GODEEEP deposit supplies a CSV freely under CC0. Weather variables include area-averaged temperature, humidity, shortwave and longwave radiation, and wind speed. Simulated load is provided both directly and scaled to 2019 annual demand to isolate weather effects. Generation columns describe the Agua Fria solar project and hypothetical solar or eighty-metre wind installations near Phoenix and Flagstaff. These joint series can support capacity-planning and weather-sensitivity simulations. Related catalogue record data-eia-2020-plant-wind-solar-hourly-profiles covers a national generation input, not this regional combined dataset. The repository labels upstream datasets as versions, but its distinct load and regional variables justify separate coverage. Neither historical population change in the scaled load nor spatial variation within averaged weather is represented. Model uncertainty, missingness and CSV values were not independently checked.
